summary: SL Science Holding Ltd, a Taiwan-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on November 3, 2026, disclosing that Dr. Ethan Shen resigned as director and Chief Technology Officer effective November 1, 2026; the board accepted the resignation and stated it was not due to any disagreement over operations, policies, or practices. On the same date the board appointed Dr. Chin-Sheng Hung as director and Chief Medical Officer, citing hospital administration and surgical leadership experience. No transaction terms, advisors, or board recommendations were disclosed. The 6-K is incorporated by reference into the Form S-8 registration statement, a routine administrative step. No deal or risk-arb angle applies.
